visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair and bangs, wearing a purple and white plaid sweater, sits indoors in front of a dark gray wall and a brown quilted leather sofa. She speaks directly to the camera with animated facial expressions and hand gestures, appearing enthusiastic. (2) The scene cuts to a screen capture of a digital news article titled 'Apple 發表全新 MacBook Air', displaying a blue laptop and Traditional Chinese text. (3) A series of product beauty shots follow, showing a thin, midnight blue metallic MacBook Air from various angles, including close-ups of the keyboard, hinges, and the Apple logo. The lighting is bright and studio-like. (4) The video transitions to a screen recording of a macOS desktop. A video call window features a different woman in a blue sweater, while a simultaneous window demonstrates the 'Desk View' feature, showing a hand writing on paper from an overhead perspective. (5) A shot shows an office worker's hand using a mouse in front of two large 6K external monitors connected to a laptop, displaying productivity software. (6) The camera returns to the main woman in the plaid sweater. She points at the camera and gestures excitedly. (7) Another screen recording shows the Apple Store's technical configuration page, highlighting spec upgrades from 8GB to 16GB RAM and price details. (8) The final scene shows the main woman clapping her hands and smiling broadly while posing a question to the viewers.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 緊接著在新 iPad 後面. (2) [Subtitle]: 蘋果在昨天晚上又發表了新的 MacBook Air. (3) [Subtitle]: 除了晶片升級成 M4. (4) [Subtitle]: 這次最大的亮點就是推出了新的天藍色. (5) [Subtitle]: 真的超美超級燒. (6) [Subtitle]: 視訊鏡頭升級到 1200 萬畫素. (7) [Subtitle]: 並且支援桌上視角功能. (8) [Subtitle]: 而且可以支援最高兩個 6K 外接顯示器. (9) [Subtitle]: 最重要價格來了. (10) [Subtitle]: 最低記憶體從前一代的 8GB 提升到 16GB. (11) [Subtitle]: 價格竟然還降了 NT$1,000. (12) [Subtitle]: 只要 NT$34,900. (13) [Subtitle]: 我真的心動了. (14) [Subtitle]: 是你的話你會買嗎? 底下留言告訴我.
